---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m2p0t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Elevators, NONE

VARIABLES status, votes, coord, requester, committedFor

vars == <<status, votes, coord, requester, committedFor>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in [Elevators -> {"idle", "voting", "holding"}]
    /\ votes \subseteq Elevators
    /\ coord \in {"idle", "collecting", "committed"}
    /\ requester \in Elevators \cup {NONE}
    /\ committedFor \in Elevators \cup {NONE}

Init ==
    /\ status = [e \in Elevators |-> "idle"]
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ coord = "idle"
    /\ requester = NONE
    /\ committedFor = NONE

Request(e) ==
    /\ coord = "idle"
    /\ status[e] = "idle"
    /\ coord' = "collecting"
    /\ requester' = e
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![e] = "voting"]
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ committedFor' = committedFor

Vote(e) ==
    /\ coord = "collecting"
    /\ e \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {e}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, coord, requester, committedFor>>

Commit ==
    /\ coord = "collecting"
    /\ votes = Elevators
    /\ requester \in Elevators
    /\ coord' = "committed"
    /\ committedFor' = requester
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![requester] = "holding"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, requester>>

Release ==
    /\ coord = "committed"
    /\ committedFor \in Elevators
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![committedFor] = "idle"]
    /\ coord' = "idle"
    /\ requester' = NONE
    /\ committedFor' = NONE
    /\ votes' = {}

AdminGrant(e) ==
    /\ status' = [f \in Elevators |-> IF f = e THEN "holding" ELSE "idle"]
    /\ committedFor' = e
    /\ coord' = "committed"
    /\ requester' = e
    /\ votes' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E e \in Elevators : Request(e)
    \/ \E e \in Elevators : Vote(e)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Release
    \/ \E e \in Elevators : AdminGrant(e)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutexCoherence ==
    \A e \in Elevators : status[e] = "holding" => committedFor = e
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Elevators = {e1, e2, e3}
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT MutexCoherence
nl:
Elevator bank in a skyscraper coordinating exclusive use of a single maintenance shaft segment via two-phase commit. A coordinator runs the protocol: an idle elevator issues a Request to enter the shaft, which opens a voting round. Every elevator (participant) casts a Vote for the current requester; only when all participants have voted does the coordinator Commit, recording the requester as the sole holder and marking it holding. When the holder is done it issues Release, clearing the grant and returning the coordinator to idle. A privileged building-maintenance admin may issue an AdminGrant that preempts the protocol and forcibly hands the shaft to a chosen elevator, but doing so must evict any prior holder so the shaft is never doubly occupied.

Actions: Request, Vote, Commit, Release, AdminGrant.

SAFETY PROPERTY: An elevator is marked as holding the shaft only if it is the unique elevator recorded as the committed grant holder, so no two elevators ever occupy the shaft simultaneously.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m6p1t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Offices, MaxEpoch, Dur, MaxTime, NONE

VARIABLES time, leaseEpoch, grantLog, expiry, inflight, rec

vars == <<time, leaseEpoch, grantLog, expiry, inflight, rec>>

Msgs == [w : Offices, ep : 1..MaxEpoch]

curOwner == IF leaseEpoch >= 1 THEN grantLog[leaseEpoch] ELSE NONE

TypeOK ==
    /\ time \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ leaseEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ grantLog \in [1..MaxEpoch -> Offices \cup {NONE}]
    /\ expiry \in 0..(MaxTime + Dur)
    /\ inflight \subseteq Msgs
    /\ rec \in [ep : 0..MaxEpoch, owner : Offices \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
    /\ time = 0
    /\ leaseEpoch = 0
    /\ grantLog = [k \in 1..MaxEpoch |-> NONE]
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ rec = [ep |-> 0, owner |-> NONE]

GrantLease(o) ==
    /\ leaseEpoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ (leaseEpoch = 0 \/ time >= expiry)
    /\ leaseEpoch' = leaseEpoch + 1
    /\ grantLog' = [grantLog EXCEPT ![leaseEpoch + 1] = o]
    /\ expiry' = time + Dur
    /\ UNCHANGED <<time, inflight, rec>>

SubmitWrite(o) ==
    /\ curOwner = o
    /\ time < expiry
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {[w |-> o, ep |-> leaseEpoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<time, leaseEpoch, grantLog, expiry, rec>>

ApplyWrite ==
    /\ \E m \in inflight :
        /\ m.ep = leaseEpoch
        /\ m.ep >= rec.ep
        /\ rec' = [ep |-> m.ep, owner |-> m.w]
        /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<time, leaseEpoch, grantLog, expiry>>

DropStale ==
    /\ \E m \in inflight :
        /\ m.ep < leaseEpoch
        /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<time, leaseEpoch, grantLog, expiry, rec>>

Tick ==
    /\ time < MaxTime
    /\ time' = time + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseEpoch, grantLog, expiry, inflight, rec>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Offices : GrantLease(o)
    \/ \E o \in Offices : SubmitWrite(o)
    \/ ApplyWrite
    \/ DropStale
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    rec.ep = 0 \/ (rec.ep <= leaseEpoch /\ grantLog[rec.ep] = rec.owner)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Offices = {o1, o2}
    MaxEpoch = 3
    Dur = 2
    MaxTime = 4
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A university course-registration system stores one shared enrollment record. Write access is governed by a renewable lease with an expiry time and an epoch number: only the current lease holder may modify the record, and each new grant increments the lease epoch and remembers, in a grant log, which registrar office was granted that epoch. Write messages travel over an unreliable channel and can be reordered or delayed, so an office may still have an in-flight write tagged with a lease epoch that has since expired. A tick advances the clock and can expire the current lease. When the lease is expired or unheld, GrantLease hands it to some office and bumps the epoch. SubmitWrite queues a write stamped with the holder's current epoch. ApplyWrite commits a queued write to the record only if its stamped epoch equals the live lease epoch, recording the writing office. DropStale discards a queued write whose stamped epoch is older than the live lease.

Actions: GrantLease, SubmitWrite, ApplyWrite, DropStale, Tick.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The committed record is always attributable to the office that legitimately held the lease for the epoch under which it was written, so a stale or reordered write from a superseded office can never overwrite the record.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m1p0t3 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS N, Cap, MaxServed

VARIABLES tokenPos, inCrit, want, inv, served

vars == <<tokenPos, inCrit, want, inv, served>>

Nodes == 0..(N-1)
nextN(n) == (n + 1) % N

TypeOK ==
    /\ tokenPos \in Nodes
    /\ inCrit \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ want \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ inv \in 0..Cap
    /\ served \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxServed]

Init ==
    /\ tokenPos = 0
    /\ inCrit = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ want = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ inv = Cap
    /\ served = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

Request(n) ==
    /\ ~want[n]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, inCrit, inv, served>>

Enter(n) ==
    /\ tokenPos = n
    /\ want[n]
    /\ ~inCrit[n]
    /\ inCrit' = [inCrit EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, want, inv, served>>

Use(n) ==
    /\ inCrit[n]
    /\ inv > 0
    /\ served[n] < MaxServed
    /\ inv' = inv - 1
    /\ served' = [served EXCEPT ![n] = served[n] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, inCrit, want>>

Exit(n) ==
    /\ inCrit[n]
    /\ inCrit' = [inCrit EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, inv, served>>

PassToken(n) ==
    /\ tokenPos = n
    /\ ~inCrit[n]
    /\ tokenPos' = nextN(n)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCrit, want, inv, served>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Request(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Enter(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Use(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Exit(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : PassToken(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RingMutex ==
    \A n \in Nodes : inCrit[n] => tokenPos = n
===========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    Cap = 2
    MaxServed = 2
INVARIANT RingMutex
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker connects three refrigeration nodes arranged in a token ring. A single token circulates; only the node currently holding the token may enter the critical section to adjust the shared inventory register. A node signals it wants access with Request. When it holds the token and wants access it may Enter the critical section, Use it to dispense a unit (adjusting the shared inventory and its own served tally), and then Exit. A node holding the token that is not in the critical section may PassToken to its ring successor. A node may be slow -- it can keep the token for a while without entering or passing -- but it never fails or vanishes, and it must not be in the critical section when it passes the token onward.

Actions: Request, Enter, Use, Exit, PassToken.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A node is in the critical section only when it currently holds the ring token, so because the token is unique at most one node ever accesses the shared inventory at a time.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m3p1t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
CONSTANTS Instances, Nodes, MaxTerm, NONE

VARIABLES term, leader, pending, hist

vars == <<term, leader, pending, hist>>

Rec == [term : 1..MaxTerm, inst : Instances, node : Nodes]
PMsg == [term : 1..MaxTerm, node : Nodes]

LastTerm == IF hist = <<>> THEN 0 ELSE hist[Len(hist)].term

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in [Instances -> 0..MaxTerm]
    /\ leader \in [Instances -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ pending \in [Instances -> (PMsg \cup {NONE})]
    /\ hist \in Seq(Rec)

Init ==
    /\ term = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ leader = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ pending = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ hist = <<>>

Elect(i, n) ==
    /\ term[i] < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![i] = term[i] + 1]
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = n]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, hist>>

Crash(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] # NONE
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, pending, hist>>

Propose(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] # NONE
    /\ pending[i] = NONE
    /\ term[i] > LastTerm
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = [term |-> term[i], node |-> leader[i]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, hist>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ pending[i] # NONE
    /\ leader[i] = pending[i].node
    /\ term[i] = pending[i].term
    /\ pending[i].term > LastTerm
    /\ hist' = Append(hist, [term |-> pending[i].term, inst |-> i, node |-> pending[i].node])
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

Discard(i) ==
    /\ pending[i] # NONE
    /\ (leader[i] # pending[i].node \/ term[i] # pending[i].term)
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, hist>>

Recover(i, n) ==
    /\ leader[i] = NONE
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = n]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, pending, hist>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, n \in Nodes : Elect(i, n)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Crash(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Propose(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Discard(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, n \in Nodes : Recover(i, n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    /\ \A k \in 1..Len(hist) : hist[k].term <= term[hist[k].inst]
    /\ \A k \in 1..(Len(hist) - 1) : hist[k].term < hist[k + 1].term
===========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {A, B}
    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    MaxTerm = 3
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A vending-machine network runs two independent controller instances (A and B) that share a single append-only ledger of price updates. Each instance elects its own leader and carries a monotonically increasing term; a failover replaces the leader and bumps the term. A leader proposes a price update stamped with its instance's current term, but the commit only lands if the leader has not failed over in the meantime, so that writes lost to a mid-flight failover never reach the ledger. Elect installs a new leader for an instance and increments its term. Crash removes an instance's leader. Propose creates a pending stamped write for an instance whose term is newer than the last committed term. Commit appends the pending write to the shared ledger only if that instance's leader and term are still exactly those it proposed under. Discard drops a pending write whose leadership or term has moved on. Recover re-installs a leader for an instance that currently has none, without changing its term.

Actions: Elect, Crash, Propose, Commit, Discard, Recover.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared ledger's committed writes have strictly increasing terms and each is stamped with a term its instance had genuinely reached, so no failover-orphaned or stale write is ever recorded and no earlier update is lost by a later lower-term write.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m6p5t0 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Jobs, Workers, Max, NONE

VARIABLES fence, holder, leaseTok, done, usedTok

vars == <<fence, holder, leaseTok, done, usedTok>>

Bump(x) == IF x < Max THEN x + 1 ELSE Max

TypeOK ==
    /\ fence \in [Jobs -> 0..Max]
    /\ holder \in [Jobs -> Workers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ leaseTok \in [Jobs -> 0..Max]
    /\ done \in [Jobs -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ usedTok \in [Jobs -> 0..Max]

Init ==
    /\ fence = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ holder = [j \in Jobs |-> NONE]
    /\ leaseTok = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ done = [j \in Jobs |-> FALSE]
    /\ usedTok = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]

Grant(j, w) ==
    /\ holder[j] = NONE
    /\ fence' = [fence EXCEPT ![j] = Bump(fence[j])]
    /\ leaseTok' = [leaseTok EXCEPT ![j] = Bump(fence[j])]
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![j] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<done, usedTok>>

SilentCrash(j) ==
    /\ holder[j] # NONE
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![j] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fence, leaseTok, done, usedTok>>

Dispense(j) ==
    /\ holder[j] # NONE
    /\ ~done[j]
    /\ fence[j] < Max
    /\ leaseTok[j] = fence[j]
    /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![j] = TRUE]
    /\ usedTok' = [usedTok EXCEPT ![j] = fence[j]]
    /\ fence' = [fence EXCEPT ![j] = fence[j] + 1]
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![j] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseTok>>

Release(j) ==
    /\ holder[j] # NONE
    /\ ~done[j]
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![j] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fence, leaseTok, done, usedTok>>

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, w \in Workers : Grant(j, w)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : SilentCrash(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Dispense(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Release(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtMostOnceFenced ==
    \A j \in Jobs :
        /\ (~done[j] => usedTok[j] = 0)
        /\ (done[j] => usedTok[j] < fence[j])
===========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Jobs = {j1, j2}
    Workers = {w1, w2}
    Max = 2
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT AtMostOnceFenced
nl:
A vending-machine network dispenses paid-for products. Each pending order is an irreversible dispense that must happen at most once. A dispatcher grants a short lease on an order to a worker; each new grant issues a strictly higher fence token so a superseded lease can be told apart from the live one. A worker may crash silently -- it simply vanishes and the order becomes ungranted again, its old token left stale -- but it must never cause the same order to be physically dispensed twice. Grant hands an ungranted order to a worker, advancing the fence and issuing that fence as the worker's lease token (the token saturates at a maximum). SilentCrash makes the current worker vanish, leaving the order ungranted. Dispense physically dispenses an order when its worker's lease token still equals the live fence and it is not yet done; dispensing marks it done, records the token it fired under, and advances the fence so that token is fenced out forever. Release lets a holding worker give the order back without dispensing.

Actions: Grant, SilentCrash, Dispense, Release.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Once an order is dispensed, the fence token it fired under is strictly older than the order's current live fence, so the dispensing lease is permanently fenced out and the irreversible dispense can never fire a second time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m4p0t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Workers, Cap, MaxShed, NONE

VARIABLES qlen, holder, phase, shed

vars == <<qlen, holder, phase, shed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ qlen \in 0..Cap
    /\ holder \in Workers \cup {NONE}
    /\ phase \in [Workers -> {"idle", "working"}]
    /\ shed \in 0..MaxShed

Init ==
    /\ qlen = 0
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ phase = [w \in Workers |-> "idle"]
    /\ shed = 0

Enqueue ==
    /\ qlen < Cap
    /\ qlen' = qlen + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, phase, shed>>

Acquire(w) ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ phase[w] = "idle"
    /\ qlen > 0
    /\ holder' = w
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "working"]
    /\ qlen' = qlen - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shed>>

Complete(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "working"
    /\ holder = w
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ shed' = IF shed < MaxShed THEN shed + 1 ELSE shed
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen>>

Crash(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "working"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, holder, shed>>

Recover ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ \A w \in Workers : phase[w] # "working"
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, phase, shed>>

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Acquire(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Complete(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Crash(w)
    \/ Recover

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BreakerMutex ==
    \A w \in Workers : phase[w] = "working" => holder = w
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Workers = {w1, w2}
    Cap = 2
    MaxShed = 3
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT BreakerMutex
nl:
A power-grid load shedder buffers shed commands in a bounded work queue with backpressure and executes them on a single critical breaker that only one actuator may operate at a time. Enqueue admits a new shed command only while the queue is below capacity (backpressure blocks producers when full). Acquire lets an idle worker take the breaker when it is free and the queue is non-empty, consuming one command and marking that worker as operating. Complete finishes an operation, releasing the breaker and bumping the completed-shed tally. A worker may crash silently while operating: Crash stops it operating but leaves the breaker still latched to it, so no other worker can seize the breaker until a supervisor acts. Recover force-releases a breaker that is latched to a worker that is no longer operating.

Actions: Enqueue, Acquire, Complete, Crash, Recover.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any worker that is currently operating the breaker is the one recorded as holding it, so two workers can never actuate the critical breaker at the same time.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m8p0t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Routers, Chutes, ADMIN, MaxRouted, NONE

VARIABLES coarse, fine, want, routed

vars == <<coarse, fine, want, routed>>

Holders == Routers \cup {ADMIN}

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Holders \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in [Chutes -> Holders \cup {NONE}]
    /\ want \in [Routers -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ routed \in 0..MaxRouted

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = [c \in Chutes |-> NONE]
    /\ want = [r \in Routers |-> FALSE]
    /\ routed = 0

Request(r) ==
    /\ ~want[r]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, routed>>

AcquireCoarse(r) ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ want[r]
    /\ coarse' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, want, routed>>

AcquireFine(r, c) ==
    /\ coarse = r
    /\ fine[c] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![c] = r]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, want, routed>>

ReleaseFine(r, c) ==
    /\ fine[c] = r
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ routed' = IF routed < MaxRouted THEN routed + 1 ELSE routed
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, want>>

ReleaseCoarse(r) ==
    /\ coarse = r
    /\ \A c \in Chutes : fine[c] # r
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, routed>>

AdminOverride ==
    /\ coarse # ADMIN
    /\ coarse' = ADMIN
    /\ fine' = [c \in Chutes |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<want, routed>>

AdminRelease ==
    /\ coarse = ADMIN
    /\ \A c \in Chutes : fine[c] # ADMIN
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, want, routed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Request(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : AcquireCoarse(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers, c \in Chutes : AcquireFine(r, c)
    \/ \E r \in Holders, c \in Chutes : ReleaseFine(r, c)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : ReleaseCoarse(r)
    \/ AdminOverride
    \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

HierLockOK ==
    \A c \in Chutes : fine[c] # NONE => coarse = fine[c]
===========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Routers = {r1, r2}
    Chutes = {c1, c2}
    ADMIN = ADMIN
    MaxRouted = 3
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT HierLockOK
nl:
An airport baggage router guards a sorting zone with a coarse zone lock and each chute inside it with a fine lock, using hierarchical locking: a router must hold the coarse zone lock before it can take any fine chute lock. Request marks a router as wanting the zone. AcquireCoarse gives the free zone lock to a wanting router. AcquireFine lets the coarse-lock holder take a free chute's fine lock. ReleaseFine drops a chute lock and counts a routed bag. ReleaseCoarse drops the zone lock once the router holds no chutes, clearing its request. A privileged operations admin can AdminOverride to seize the zone lock, which must evict the previous holder and clear every fine chute lock so the hierarchy stays consistent; AdminRelease later frees the admin-held zone.

Actions: Request, AcquireCoarse, AcquireFine, ReleaseFine, ReleaseCoarse, AdminOverride, AdminRelease.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A chute's fine lock is held only by whoever currently holds the coarse zone lock, so no router (or admin) ever operates a chute without owning the enclosing zone and two parties never share a chute.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m7p1t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Instances, MaxSeq, MaxVer, NONE

VARIABLES reg, ver, committed, pending, seq

vars == <<reg, ver, committed, pending, seq>>

WriteIds == {<<i, k>> : i \in Instances, k \in 1..MaxSeq}
Proposals == [id : WriteIds, base : 0..MaxVer]

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \subseteq WriteIds
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ committed \subseteq WriteIds
    /\ pending \in [Instances -> Proposals \cup {NONE}]
    /\ seq \in [Instances -> 0..MaxSeq]

Init ==
    /\ reg = {}
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ pending = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ seq = [i \in Instances |-> 0]

Read(i) ==
    /\ pending[i] = NONE
    /\ seq[i] < MaxSeq
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = [id |-> <<i, seq[i] + 1>>, base |-> ver]]
    /\ seq' = [seq EXCEPT ![i] = seq[i] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, ver, committed>>

CommitCAS(i) ==
    /\ pending[i] # NONE
    /\ pending[i].base = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ reg' = reg \cup {pending[i].id}
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {pending[i].id}
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seq>>

RetryCAS(i) ==
    /\ pending[i] # NONE
    /\ pending[i].base # ver
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, ver, committed, seq>>

NewShift ==
    /\ ver > 0
    /\ reg' = {}
    /\ ver' = 0

    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer

    /\ readVer \in [Instances -> 0..MaxVer]

    /\ version = 0
    /\ phase = [i \in Instances |-> "idle"]

    /\ readVer[i] = version
    /\ owner' = i
    /\ version' = Bump(version)
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "cs"]

    /\ (owner # NONE \/ readVer[i] # version)
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version, readVer>>

    /\ owner = i
    /\ owner' = NONE
    /\ version' = Bump(version)
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]

    /\ pending \subseteq Reqs

    /\ r.epoch = se[r.player]
    /\ slotEpoch' = [slotEpoch EXCEPT ![r.player] = r.epoch]

Each player has a session with an epoch, and requests carry the epoch under which they were issued.     /\ studentSeat' = [studentSeat EXCEPT ![st] = se]
    /\ seatStudent' = [seatStudent EXCEPT ![se] = st]
    /\ served' = served + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos>>

Release(st) ==
    /\ studentSeat[st] # NONE
    /\ seatStudent' = [seatStudent EXCEPT ![studentSeat[st]] = NONE]
    /\ studentSeat' = [studentSeat EXCEPT ![st] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, served>>

PassToken(o) ==
    /\ o = tokenPos
    /\ tokenPos' = (o + 1) % NumOffices
    /\ UNCHANGED <<studentSeat, seatStudent, served>>

AdminGrant(st, se) ==
    /\ studentSeat[st] = NONE
    /\ seatStudent[se] = NONE
    /\ served < MaxServed
    /\ studentSeat' = [studentSeat EXCEPT ![st] = se]
    /\ seatStudent' = [seatStudent EXCEPT ![se] = st]
    /\ served' = served + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Offices, st \in Students, se \in Seats : Grant(o, st, se)
    \/ \E st \in Students : Release(st)
    \/ \E o \in Offices : PassToken(o)
    \/ \E st \in Students, se \in Seats : AdminGrant(st, se)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SeatCoherence ==
    /\ \A st \in Students : studentSeat[st] # NONE => seatStudent[studentSeat[st]] = st
    /\ \A se \in Seats : seatStudent[se] # NONE => studentSeat[seatStudent[se]] = se
=============================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    NumOffices = 3
    Students = {st1, st2}
    Seats = {se1, se2}
    MaxServed = 3
    NONE = NONE
INVARIANT SeatCoherence
nl:
A university course-registration system lets a ring of registrar offices grant course seats to students, where exclusive granting authority circulates as a single ring token: only the office currently holding the token may grant a seat, so grants are serialized and the same seat is never handed to two students. Two mirrored maps record each student's granted seat and each seat's assigned student. Grant lets the token-holding office give a free seat to a seat-less student, updating both maps together and counting the grant (grants are capped per session). Release frees a student's seat, clearing both maps. PassToken hands the ring token to the next office. A privileged registration admin may AdminGrant a free seat to a seat-less student bypassing the token, still updating both maps consistently.

Actions: Grant, Release, PassToken, AdminGrant.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The student-to-seat and seat-to-student maps are always mutual inverses on assigned entries, so no seat is ever granted to two different students at once.

VARIABLES qlen, load, doorOpen, slow

vars == <<qlen, load, doorOpen, slow>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ qlen \in 0..QCap
    /\ load \in 0..MaxLoad
    /\ doorOpen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ slow \in 0..MaxSlow

Init ==
    /\ qlen = 0
    /\ load = 0
    /\ doorOpen = FALSE
    /\ slow = 0

HallCall ==
    /\ qlen < QCap
    /\ qlen' = qlen + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, doorOpen, slow>>

OpenDoor ==
    /\ ~doorOpen
    /\ doorOpen' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, load, slow>>

Board ==
    /\ doorOpen
    /\ load < CarCap
    /\ qlen > 0
    /\ load' = load + 1
    /\ qlen' = qlen - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<doorOpen, slow>>

Alight ==
    /\ load > 0
    /\ load' = load - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, doorOpen, slow>>

CloseDoor ==
    /\ doorOpen
    /\ doorOpen' = FALSE
    /\ slow' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, load>>

Dawdle ==
    /\ doorOpen
    /\ slow < MaxSlow
    /\ slow' = slow + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, load, doorOpen>>

Next ==
    \/ HallCall
    \/ OpenDoor
    \/ Board
    \/ Alight
    \/ CloseDoor
    \/ Dawdle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CarCapOK == load <= CarCap

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    QCap = 2
    CarCap = 2
    MaxLoad = 3
    MaxSlow = 2
INVARIANT CarCapOK
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper buffers hall calls in a bounded work queue with backpressure and serves them with a single car that has a fixed passenger capacity that must never be exceeded. HallCall adds a waiting call to the queue only while it is below its capacity (backpressure blocks new calls when the queue is full). OpenDoor opens the car doors at a floor. Board lets one waiting passenger enter the car while the doors are open and the car load is strictly below capacity, consuming one queued call. Alight lets a passenger leave the car. CloseDoor closes the doors and moves the car on, resetting the slowness counter. Dawdle models a slow car that lingers with doors open; it is slow but never fails, and its slowness is bounded.

Actions: HallCall, OpenDoor, Board, Alight, CloseDoor, Dawdle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of passengers in the car never exceeds the car's fixed passenger capacity, no matter how calls are queued or how slow the car is.
